alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'hammerhead' class. artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from mild generative artifacts, primarily in the background texture which appears painterly and repetitive (severity ~1.5). The subject itself has slight edge softness/blur, noted by both the Router and the Perceptual Auditor. While the topology is intact (high mask confidence), the lack of crisp detail and the 'dreamy' quality of the water/seabed indicate it is not a pristine real photograph. It is better than the 'mid' reference (000002) which had more noticeable structural weirdness, but worse than a high-quality real photo due to the texture issues.
